001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.QuickShopAPI;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.ShopPermissionAudience;
005import com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList;
006import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
007
008import java.util.List;
009import java.util.Locale;
010
011import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.ACCESS_INVENTORY;
012import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.PREVIEW_SHOP;
013import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.PURCHASE;
014import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.RECEIVE_ALERT;
015import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SEARCH;
016import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SET_BENEFIT;
017import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SET_CURRENCY;
018import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SET_ITEM;
019import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SET_PRICE;
020import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SET_SHOPTYPE;
021import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SET_SHOP_STATE;
022import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SET_SIGN_TYPE;
023import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SET_STACK_AMOUNT;
024import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.SHOW_INFORMATION;
025import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.TOGGLE_DISPLAY;
026import static com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.permission.BuiltInShopPermission.VIEW_PURCHASE_LOGS;
027
028public enum BuiltInShopPermissionGroup implements ShopPermissionAudience {
029  BLOCKED("blocked", "blocked"),
030  EVERYONE("everyone", "everyone", PURCHASE, SHOW_INFORMATION, PREVIEW_SHOP, SEARCH),
031  STAFF("staff", "staff", PURCHASE, SHOW_INFORMATION, PREVIEW_SHOP, SEARCH, ACCESS_INVENTORY,
032        TOGGLE_DISPLAY, SET_SHOPTYPE, SET_SHOP_STATE, SET_PRICE, SET_ITEM, SET_STACK_AMOUNT,
033        SET_CURRENCY, RECEIVE_ALERT, SET_BENEFIT, SET_SIGN_TYPE, VIEW_PURCHASE_LOGS),
034  ADMINISTRATOR("administrator", "administrator", BuiltInShopPermission.values());
035
036  private final String node;
037  private final String descriptionKey;
038  private final List<BuiltInShopPermission> permissions;
039
040  BuiltInShopPermissionGroup(@NotNull final String node, @NotNull final String descriptionKey, @NotNull final BuiltInShopPermission... permissions) {
041
042    this.node = node;
043    this.descriptionKey = descriptionKey;
044    this.permissions = ImmutableList.copyOf(permissions);
045  }
046
047  @NotNull
048  public String getDescriptionKey() {
049
050    return descriptionKey;
051  }
052
053  @Override
054  public @NotNull String getName() {
055
056    return this.descriptionKey;
057  }
058
059  /**
060   * Check specific permission is/or contains the given permission.
061   *
062   * @param permission The permission to check.
063   *
064   * @return True if the given permission is/or contains the given permission.
065   */
066  @Override
067  public boolean hasPermission(@NotNull final BuiltInShopPermission permission) {
068
069    return this.getPermissions().contains(permission);
070  }
071
072  @Override
073  public boolean hasPermission(@NotNull final String permission) {
074
075    return node.contains(permission);
076  }
077
078  @NotNull
079  public List<BuiltInShopPermission> getPermissions() {
080
081    return permissions;
082  }
083
084  @NotNull
085  public String getNamespacedNode() {
086
087    return QuickShopAPI.getPluginInstance().getName().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT) + "." + this.node;
088  }
089
090  @NotNull
091  public String getRawNode() {
092
093    return node;
094  }
095}
